tasks.DefineProblem: Understand the problem of finding the longest common subsequence between two sequences.
tasks.DesignAlgorithm: Design an algorithm to solve the problem based on dynamic programming with optimization for larger input sizes.
tasks.ImplementFunction: Write a Python function implementing the designed algorithm, considering space and time optimizations.
tasks.OptimizeAlgorithm: Refine the algorithm if necessary based on performance considerations.
tasks.TestFunction: Run tests to ensure the function works as expected, including edge cases like no common subsequences.
